subject: Third‑party hosting change: impact to DPA / evidence request
messages:
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@finsecure.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Peter Liu <peter.liu@cloudharbor.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Question: third‑party hosting change — impact to DPA & evidence

Hi David,

Quick one — Procurement and InfoSec at FinSecure are reviewing an upcoming change: our telemetry vendor (CloudHarbor Analytics) is moving a subset of their hosting from our current EU tenant into a new EU region managed by their partner (CloudHarbor Infrastructure). Before we escalate to legal, can you help with the following from Redwood?

- A current list of Redwood subprocessors (full inventory) and clear indication whether CloudHarbor Infrastructure will be added as a subprocessor for our account.
- Any evidence that would show no change to cross‑border flows (data residency statement, dataflow diagram).
- SOC2 or comparable attestation for the partner (if available).
- Expected timeline to provide the above and whether you need a DPA addendum signature.

I've attached a lightly annotated copy of our DPA to show the clause procurement is worried about. We want to avoid a procurement hold on our renewal — a fast packet would help.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Jenkins
Director, Infrastructure Risk – FinSecure Bank
sarah.jenkins@finsecure.com
+1 415 555 0123

Attachment: FinSecure_DPA_annotated.pdf

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@finsecure.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Peter Liu <peter.liu@cloudharbor.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question: third‑party hosting change — impact to DPA & evidence

Sarah — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the annotated DPA. Short answers up front, then next steps: 

- Inventory: I attached our current subprocessor inventory (redwood_subprocessor_inventory_20260615.xlsx). CloudHarbor Analytics is already listed as a processing partner for telemetry/analytics. CloudHarbor Infrastructure (the partner you mention) is not currently on the inventory.
- Residency / dataflow: based on our intake with CloudHarbor, the planned region is within the EU and their partner will host within EU boundaries; we do not expect cross‑border egress to non‑EU jurisdictions for FinSecure traffic. I attached a short hosting change matrix with the vendor's stated flows.
- Attestations: CloudHarbor Infrastructure has provided a vendor attestation; I'll add it to the packet. We also have our own SOC2 report (redacted) that covers telemetry handoffs; I'll include the redacted SOC2 report as part of the evidence bundle.
- DPA addendum: we may need a small addendum to name the subcontractor; procurement can sign a short schedule amendment.

Next steps proposed: Mina from Security will assemble a minimal evidence packet (SOC2 redaction, dataflow diagram, subprocessor agreement excerpt, and encryption/KMS notes). Can we target EOD Wednesday (2026‑06‑17) for the packet? If procurement needs DocuSign for the addendum we can initiate it once you confirm the packet.

Phone if easier: 415‑555‑0100.

Best,
David Kim
Enterprise Sales – Redwood Inference
(direct) david.kim@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_subprocessor_inventory_20260615.xlsx, hosting_change_matrix.pdf

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@finsecure.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question: third‑party hosting change — impact to DPA & evidence

Hi Sarah / team — looping in compliance details and a proposed evidence checklist. Thanks for the clear ask, David. We can provide a single packet that should satisfy FinSecure's review and Procurement. Below are deliverables and an ETA.

Deliverables (single ZIP/drive folder):
- Redacted SOC2 Type II report (covering telemetry and infrastructure handoffs) — redwood + vendor excerpts.
- Dataflow diagram and narrative showing that FinSecure customer traffic remains EU‑resident (no outbound egress to non‑EEA).
- Subprocessor agreement excerpt between Redwood and CloudHarbor Infrastructure (showing contractual safeguards, encryption at rest, access controls).
- Encryption / KMS handling note: CloudHarbor Infrastructure does not hold master keys for customer data; keys are segregated where applicable and managed via KMS with customer‑segregated namespaces.
- Minimal evidence summary (one‑page) that procurement can attach to the DPA addendum.

Timeline: we will assemble the packet and upload to a secure Drive folder by EOD 2026‑06‑17 (48 hours). If you need a sooner partial packet (SOC2 excerpt + dataflow) we can push by EOD today with an interim note.

DPA addendum: if FinSecure requires an explicit connector naming the partner, we can prepare a 1‑page schedule amendment and send a DocuSign link for signature. Karthik (cc'd) is available for any legal redline questions.

I have attached the SOC2 redaction and the inventory extract for your quick review. If procurement needs a zipped packet via your secure intake, tell us the preferred upload mechanism and we will comply.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Security & Compliance Manager – Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

Attachments: soc2_report_redacted.pdf, subprocessor_inventory_excerpt_20260615.xlsx

David / Mina — perfect, thanks. EOD Thursday (2026‑06‑17) is fine for the full packet; Procurement will want the SOC2 excerpt and the dataflow sooner if possible — please send those first if you can.

Two quick asks from procurement:
1) Please upload the packet to a FinSecure intake folder (we prefer vendor uploads via Google Drive with restricted link). If you can provide the Drive URL and ACL scope, that will speed our review.
2) Please start a DocuSign for the one‑page schedule amendment naming CloudHarbor Infrastructure as a subprocessor so procurement can loop legal early.

I'll unblock renewal on our side once we have the SOC2 excerpt and the schedule amendment in DocuSign.

Thanks again — we appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Sarah
Director, Infrastructure Risk – FinSecure Bank
